subtitle: Ipuzzle yakudala ye-3×3
short_description: Shintshela amathayili anezinombolo ukuze ahleleke, ukunyakaza kanye ngesikhathi.
description:
Shintshela amathayili anezinombolo esikhaleni esingenalutho ebhodini le-3×3 uze zifundeke ngokulandelana kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-8. Amalungiselelo okuqala ahlukahluka kusukela ezinyathelweni ezimbalwa kuya kwezingu-14 kusukela ekuxazululeni.

Thepha ithayili eliseduze nesikwele esingenalutho ukuze liyishintshele khona. Hlehlisa noqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
